title: Meteora Capital Exits Top SPACs, Diversifying $1.2B Book
ai_summary: Meteora Capital, LLC has reduced its reported portfolio value to $1.21 billion for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, following a significant shift away from special purpose acquisition companies (SPACs). The portfolio has expanded from 384 to 444 holdings, with notable exits from core SPAC positions including M3-Brigade Acquisition V Corp, Cantor Equity Partners I Inc, and Republic Digital Acquisition Co, amounting to approximately $103 million in reported value. The upcoming filing is anticipated to provide more details regarding the new portfolio composition and sector rotations.
